title: Kanna settings
description: Kanna's settings, version 1: ~/.kanna-v4/config.json, overridden key by key by a repo's .kanna/config.json (except agents.prompts, which only yours sets). Print this with `kanna config schema`.

version.description: The settings format this file is written for. Kanna skips a file with a version newer than it knows, and says so in its log.

planning.description: The planning terminal: the terminal docked in the Desk view, beside the Desk's tasks and the Shelf.

agent.description: The agent a new Desk's planning terminal starts as the planning agent. Unset, it asks which (unless one agent is installed) and offers to write the answer to the repo's .kanna/config.json. Read by the planning terminal when it starts.

context.description: Tokens a claude agent's context grows to in the planning terminal before it compacts (CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW), or "auto" for claude's own. Read when a planning terminal is made.

shelf.description: A repo's Shelf: the tasks Kanna has brought in that aren't on the Desk.

runners.description: How many of a repo's Shelf tasks run at once. Waiting tasks start by themselves, oldest first, skipping blocked ones, and Kanna stops each when its agent's turn ends (it asks you something or it's finished), freeing its place for the next; move a stopped task to the Desk to resume it. 0 turns this off: Kanna starts and stops none. Read every few seconds.

backlog.description: The old name of shelf, still read: shelf.runners, if set in the same file, wins.

tasks.description: A repo's tasks: the agent each runs, and what they run as their worktree is made and when they're Done (docs/specs/task-scripts.md). Each command runs with your login shell in the task's worktree, with KANNA_TASK, KANNA_TASK_NAME, KANNA_REPO, KANNA_WORKTREE, KANNA_BRANCH and KANNA_BASE set.

agent.description: The agent a new task runs when kanna task new has no --agent: an agent Kanna knows (claude, codex, copilot, opencode, agy), or in your ~/.kanna-v4/config.json any command that starts one ("claude --model opus"). A repo's .kanna/config.json may only name an agent, so a repo you clone can't make Kanna run a command of its choosing. Read when a task is made; the task keeps it.

setup.description: A shell command (or a script path from the repo's root, such as .kanna/setup.sh) run in a new task's worktree, in its agent's terminal, before the agent starts; once per worktree. If it fails, the task stops, and `kanna task start` starts the agent anyway or `kanna task setup` runs it again.

teardown.description: A shell command run in a task's worktree when it's Done, before Kanna removes anything. If it succeeds, and the branch is merged and the worktree has no changes, Kanna removes the worktree (and the folder its target/ links to) and deletes the branch.

timeout.description: Seconds setup and teardown each get before Kanna stops them.

agents.description: The agents Kanna starts: task agents, quiz agents and planning agents.

prompts.description: Whether the agents Kanna starts ask permission before running commands and editing files ("ask"), or skip their permission prompts ("skip": claude --dangerously-skip-permissions, codex --yolo, copilot --yolo, agy --dangerously-skip-permissions). An agent command that already picks its own mode keeps it. Only ~/.kanna-v4/config.json sets this: a repo's .kanna/config.json that sets it is ignored, so a cloned repo can't turn your prompts off. Unset, agents ask, and the planning terminal asks you once and writes your answer here. Read when an agent's command is built.
